name: Double M Dental Clinic

summary_en: Double M Dental Clinic is a dental facility located in Bangkok that holds a perfect 5-star rating based on 5 total reviews. The clinic maintains a trust score of 58.4 and specializes in professional dental care services for patients in the city.
